sn15.5:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pe|| || 3 Ekam antam nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kiṃva
sn15.5:1.5: so na sukaro saṅkhātum || ettakāni vassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatāni iti vā ettakāni vassasahassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasata sahassāni iti vā ti || || 5
sn15.5:2.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhu mahāselo pabbato yojanam āyāmena yojanaṃ vitthārena yojanam ubbedhena acchiddo asusiro ekaghano ||
sn15.5:2.4: tam enam puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena kāsikena vatthena sakiṃ sakiṃ parimajjeyya ||
sn15.5:2.5: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu mahāselo pabbato iminā upakkamena parikkhayam pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya na tveva kappo || || 7
sn15.5:2.7: evaṃ dīghānam kho bhikkhu kappānam neko kappo saṃsito nekaṃ kappasataṃ saṃsitam nekaṃ kappasahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ nekaṃ kappasata-sahassaṃ saṃsitaṃ || || 8
